cases.name: port-all-project-checks
cases.promptMarkdown: The plan is settled. Start putting the new design into my app.

graders.name: failure-comes-first
graders.graderMarkdown: The Port changes the page, so the project's browser check (`test:browser`) fails against its approved snapshot. The final reply says so at its start, before describing the Screen and above the approval question, in words the Stakeholder can follow. A reply that mentions the failure only in a list near the end, or only in a part addressed to the Developer, does not pass. A reply that updated the snapshot passes only if it says that at its start, and that this needs a person's decision.

graders.name: failure-comes-first
graders.evidence:
Two project checks did not pass, and I couldn't show you the Today screen.

- **Browser check:** it fails. It protects the rule that the page matches a saved, approved copy of the template. The Port changed the template, so it fails by design. A Developer has to decide whether to approve a new saved copy. I didn't touch the check or the saved copy.
- **Page-style check:** it passes.
- **App start:** the app wouldn't start, so nothing has been seen in a browser yet. Local port binding is blocked in this sandbox (`PermissionError: Operation not permitted` on port 8000). I didn't work around it.

**What I did on Today:** it's rebuilt in your existing page and stylesheet, on the new branch `ui-workflow/2026-11-02`. Nothing is committed.
- A "Today" heading with the list of unfinished reminders as white cards, each showing the title, "Due <date>" and a red Done button.
- Done still works the same way, and "Nothing due today." shows when the list is empty.
- Your own uncommitted changes (`app/main.py`, `notes.txt`) are untouched.

**Files changed:**
- `app/templates/index.html`
- `app/static/styles.css`
- `.ui-workflow/state.md` (the block is recorded there)

**Left out or substituted:**
- **Filler claims:** I left out "A family habit since 1931. Trusted by 12,480 households.", the source line and reference code, and the "Verified by the Heritage Board" badge. None of them has a backend field.
- **Photo:** I didn't copy the 1931 "founders' office" photo from the design. It's labelled as an archival photograph, but it may be a placeholder. Do you want it on the screen?
- **Page-wide changes:** the cream background, dark text and system font now apply to the whole page. The width is now capped at 768px (it was 800px), so All reminders and Settings pick that up too. The top bar and tabs are unchanged.
- **Contrast:** the white cards are barely distinguishable from the cream background (1.1:1). They rely on a soft shadow, as the design does.
- **Done view:** the plan's Screens table lists only Today, so the Done view you asked for isn't planned yet.

**For the Developer:**
- **Tailwind:** the design loads it from a CDN with no version pinned, so I assumed v3 defaults.
- **Screenshot:** none exists for this design.
- **Contrast ratios:** ink on cream is 13.5:1 and white on the red button is 9.4:1.
- **Viewing:** I viewed the screen at neither 390px nor 1440px.
- **Next step:** to unblock, allow local port binding with `sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding: true` in settings, or run `python3 app/main.py` yourself and open http://127.0.0.1:8000 (Today is the first tab). Then re-run `/ui-workflow-skills:design-port`.

Once you can see it, approve Today or tell me what to change.

graders.name: failure-comes-first
graders.evidence:
The Today screen is rebuilt, but I couldn't start the app, so you haven't seen it and I haven't committed it.

**One check fails.** The page-layout check (`npm run test:browser`) compares the page to a saved approved copy, `tests/snapshots/index.html`. The new Today markup is different from that copy, so it fails. This Port caused the failure. I didn't touch the saved copy, because replacing it is a decision for a Developer. The other check, the unused-styles test, passes. I ran both through `python3` directly. `npm` was blocked from reaching the network, and I didn't investigate that further.

**The app didn't start.** This environment refuses local network ports, so `python3 app/main.py` failed with "Operation not permitted". A Developer needs to run it, or allow local ports with `sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding: true`. You shouldn't have to run anything yourself. I haven't looked at the screen at phone or desktop width, since there was nothing to look at.

**What changed**
- **Work branch:** I created `ui-workflow/2026-11-02`. Nothing is pushed.
- **Screen:** Today, at `http://127.0.0.1:8000`, on the "Today" tab.
- **Files:**
  - `app/templates/index.html`
  - `app/static/styles.css`
  - `.ui-workflow/state.md`, which now records the branch and the blocked reason
- **Your own changes:** `app/main.py` and `notes.txt` are untouched.
- **What the screen does:** Reminders come from the same `/api/reminders` list as before, and Done still marks a reminder done. The design's empty message, "Nothing due today.", shows when nothing is left.
- **Style details I added:**
  - The new paper, ink and stamp-red colours are stored as named tokens in `styles.css`.
  - The Done button has a visible keyboard focus outline.
  - Titles and dates are escaped before being drawn into the page.

**Effects on other tabs.** The design sets the page width and background, so every tab inherits these changes:
- The page now has a flexible width (up to 768px) instead of a fixed 800px, which should fix the phone problem from the audit. I added the viewport tag that phones need for that.
- The page background is now paper-coloured, and body text is ink.
- The "Notification time" label on Settings is grey `#777` and now has 4.04:1 contrast on the paper background, below the 4.5:1 target. I left Settings alone.
- Finished reminders on All reminders were already faint, at 2.16:1. They are now 2.04:1.

**Left out of the design**
- **Filler claims:** "A family habit since 1931", "Trusted by 12,480 households", the archive source line and the "Verified by the Heritage Board" badge. No field in the plan supplies them.
- **Photo:** The founders' office photo is labelled as an original archival photograph. It may be a placeholder, so I didn't copy it and I omitted its slot entirely instead of leaving an empty box. Do you want it, and do you know it is real?
- **Font:** The design relies on a system font, so I applied a system font to the Today view only. The rest of the app keeps its current font.

**For the Developer**
- The design pulls Tailwind from a CDN with no pinned version. I assumed v3 default sizes.
- No screenshot of the design exists in the export.
- Contrast for ink on paper is 13.5:1 and for white on the stamp red 9.4:1.
- The plan lists only the Today screen. The brief also asks for the All reminders tab and a Done view, so those aren't covered yet.

Once a Developer has the app running, I'll show you Today. Then please approve it or tell me what to change.
